derived_from: the _BLK prototype set, corrected — art unchanged, material data rebuilt
note: the _BLK set is retained unmodified alongside this one. output/imagegen/ is gitignored, so neither set is under version control.
emissive_note: CORRECTED. SurfaceAppearance does expose EmissiveMaskContent (grayscale mask) plus EmissiveStrength and EmissiveTint. The Neon conduit overlay is no longer required. The emissive map here is RGB cyan — convert to grayscale for EmissiveMaskContent and move the cyan into EmissiveTint. Confirm availability in your Studio version.
row_boundaries_note: row boundaries re-cut to where the artwork actually transitions. the _BLK contract had them 75px, 69px and 20px off for rows 01-03, which split single features across two material values.
corrections_applied: row boundaries re-cut to the measured art transitions (331/517/596/793/927, snapped to multiples of 16)
baked ambient occlusion regressed out of the colour map (was corr -0.47..-0.71 against a cavity proxy)
albedo lifted off the PBR floor: median 32 -> 49 on dielectric rows
metal rows raised to physically real reflectance: 36 sRGB -> 152/175/118 (metals reflect 50-98%, i.e. sRGB 130-240)
known_remaining_limitations: roughness still carries only 5-10% of scale of variation within each row. it is effectively a per-row constant plus a whisper of relief detail, and adds little a flat material value would not. fixing this needs wear/cavity data that was never authored — an AO+curvature bake against the existing art, or a re-author.
the row-01 circuit-elbow motif is a recognisable landmark that repeats visibly at 2x tiling. minor, but it is the 'no contextual details' rule from the Roblox trim-sheet guidance.

verification.tiling_x: seam gap indistinguishable from local neighbour gaps; 0.9% of rows flagged on colour, 3.2% on normal
verification.metalness_binary: 60.9% below 25, 34.4% above 230, 0.0% in the muddy 77-178 middle
verification.mip_alignment: every row boundary lands on a multiple of 16, so bands sit on clean texel edges down to mip 4
verification.studio_test: MaterialVariant on 10x10 parts, StudsPerTile 10, part Color white, place lighting untouched (ClockTime 14.5, Brightness 3). metal rows read as metal; the _BLK set renders them as a black void at every camera angle.
